newsitem.title: USA: McDermott stake raised by Soros group.
newsitem.headline: McDermott stake raised by Soros group.

text.p: A group led by U.S. investor George Soros said Tuesday it raised its stake in McDermott International Inc to 4,208,200 common shares, or 7.66 percent, from 6.79 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included stock purchases between March 13 and April 3 at prices ranging from $20.31 to $22.167 per share.
McDermott International, based in New Orleans, builds power generation systems for utilties and offshore structures for the oil industry.
